perspective:
**Alice Lim’s available information:**

- Alice knows she is a dental hygienist. She and Austin are old friends from high school, remain close, discuss their personal/professional lives, and support each other.
- She noticed Austin had become reserved when talking about work and suspected he might be hiding something about his job performance. She felt concerned and curious.
- She invited Austin for coffee. She asked if everything was okay at the office.
- Austin told her it was “nothing really,” just “the usual ups and downs,” and later said he wasn’t sure how to handle a few things at work and that it was complicated.
- Alice later believed Austin might be considering a career change because of dissatisfaction at work. She worried about his well-being.
- She asked Austin if he had ever thought about changing careers. Austin said he had, but wasn’t sure what other paths he could take, and asked what she suggested.
- Alice suggested healthcare, said it needs dedicated people, and offered to tell him more and connect him with contacts. Austin said that sounded interesting and wanted to know more about her experiences.
- Alice sensed Austin was hesitant about changing careers due to fear of the unknown. She felt frustration and empathy.
- She told Austin changing careers can be daunting but many succeed, and shared that her friend Lara switched to healthcare in her late 30s and has never been happier.
- Austin said that was inspiring but he worried about risks and the initial struggle. Alice said that was natural, growth comes from stepping outside comfort zones, and she would support him. Austin thanked her and said her support and real success stories helped.
- Seeing Austin’s openness, Alice felt encouraged and hopeful. She suggested he talk to a career counselor and said she had friends in healthcare who could give a clearer picture.
- Austin said that would be helpful and appreciated her help with connections. Alice said she would set up a meeting for them next week. Austin thanked her and said he was looking forward to it.
- After several discussions and meetings, Alice believed Austin was ready to take next steps and appreciated her help. She felt satisfaction and joy.
- She told Austin she was proud of the steps he had taken and asked how he felt. Austin said he felt excited, a bit nervous, but mostly grateful for her help.
- Alice said that was normal and suggested regular check-ins. Austin agreed, saying it would keep him focused and that he valued her perspective.

**Not available to Alice as confirmed fact:** the specific details of Austin’s work problems beyond “a few things” and “complicated”; whether he was actually hiding job-performance issues; his private reasons for hesitancy; and whether he will ultimately change careers. Those remain her suspicions, perceptions, or beliefs based on what he said and how he acted.
